case_status: Every row is an unvalidated sensitivity case, NOT a selected or guaranteed condition. Zero solar and full heat capture are ideal limits only.
model_limits: Lumped steady-state linear reference network; not CFD, transient, radiation or a qualification model.
All baseline enclosed heat and48W potential absorbed-sun budget retained. Geometry does not justify setting residual solar fraction to zero.
Natural-convection catalog sink reference lacks installed boundary conditions; multipliers are exploratory, not certified bounds.
Pad area scaling and common wall/spreader conduction neglect nonuniform clamping, lateral spreading, casting texture, source-package contacts and collector-to-air feedback.
Full rectangular internal wallarea is an optimistic exchange-area allocation; component blockage and actual flow/radiation/coupling are not measured.
A conditional numerical air-temperature inequality is not actual local Pi/DAQ/converter ambient or junction qualification.
